command: bash -lc 'LOCK=/tmp/c720p-job-990037.lock; mkdir "$LOCK" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; UNIT=$(systemctl --user list-unit-files --no-legend 2>/dev/null | awk '''$1 ~ /c720p.*agent/ {print $1; exit}'''); if [ -n "$UNIT" ]; then systemctl --user restart "$UNIT"; sleep 2; systemctl --user is-active "$UNIT"; else echo NO_C720P_AGENT_UNIT; fi'
